# ML DSA Composite key generation test vectors.
# Source: https://github.com/lamps-wg/draft-composite-sigs/blob/main/src/testvectors.json
#
# Each stanza derives the ml dsa composite key pair from the IETF sk bytes
# (mldsaSeed || tradSK) and verifies that the resulting pub/priv match.
#
# RSA-PSS composites only; see the _ec file for the other family.

# --- ML-DSA-44-RSA2048-PSS-SHA256 ---
KeyGen = ML-DSA-44-RSA2048-PSS-SHA256
KeyName = keygen_MLDSA44_RSA2048_PSS_SHA256
Ctrl = hexpriv:
CtrlOut = hexpub:
CtrlOut = hexpriv:

# --- ML-DSA-87-RSA4096-PSS-SHA512 ---
KeyGen = ML-DSA-87-RSA4096-PSS-SHA512
KeyName = keygen_MLDSA87_RSA4096_PSS_SHA512
Ctrl = hexpriv:
CtrlOut = hexpub:
CtrlOut = hexpriv:
